title: Bugs Bunny and Friends
description: Three classic Looney Tunes characters stand side by side on a painted floor against a textured backdrop. From left to right are the lanky brown dog with a wide grin, Bugs Bunny in the center with a confident pose, and a grey rabbit wearing a red bow tie striking a suave pose.
prompt: Three Looney Tunes characters standing together: a tall brown dog with long ears and a big smile on the left, classic grey Bugs Bunny with white muzzle and gloves standing confidently in the center, and a grey rabbit with red bow tie and red shoes posing suavely on the right. They are on a light colored floor with scattered leaves and flowers against a dark textured painterly background, in a vibrant cartoon style with dramatic lighting and shadows.
